definitions.arrival_clock: all arrivals are zero; window-arrival cohort empty (N/A); warm admission cohort arrival-clock SLO separately retained
definitions.exclusions: four seed7 pilot configurations excluded from this 40-cell main comparison
definitions.group_statistics: five seeds equally weighted; sample SD; no partial five-seed aggregates; condition failures retained
definitions.input_pairing: original_request_id; full remaining load, arrival and actual block placement invariant, permitting only NPU/order-encoding fields to change
definitions.nominal_capacity: independently re-scanned half-open admission-completion current-request physical V_s/C; ties batched; no additional L0 term; not instantaneous physical SSD throughput
definitions.source_of_U_SLO: independent standard-library calculation; no imported runner/analyzer metric functions
definitions.warm_SLO: admission in [2000,4000), completion-admission <= 1.5 * manifest 8C; follow to completion without truncating at 4000
